Port of Sindangan. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of
Sindangan situated in the Municipality of Sindangan, Province of Zamboanga del
Norte, is hereby delineated and established, particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, being N. 27 deg. 36' W.,
2,305.36 m. from ZGN No. 3, NAMRIA, thence:

PPA Jurisdiction. The Sindangan Port Zone, as delineated,
is hereby placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the PPA, which shall,
consistent with the regional industrial plans of the government, implement a
program for the proper zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed,
amended or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is
declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall
remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately
upon publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 4th day of December , in the year
of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twelve.
By the President:
PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
